| `fields`      | `Array<object>` | ✓        | —       | The fields: `[{ key, label, type?, hint?, placeholder?, required?, pattern?, patternMessage?, min?, max?, rows?, options?, optionsUrl?, optionsPath?, optionLabel?, optionValue?, default?, readOnly?, wide?, url?, valuePath?, saveUrl?, saveMethod?, saveKey?, uploadUrl?, uploadField?, uploadParams?, uploadValuePath?, initials?, initialsFrom? }]`. `type` is `text` (default), `textarea`, `number`, `switch`, `select`, `secret` or `image`. `key` names the setting; a dotted key reads a nested value and is written as written. A field with its own `url` is read there (at `valuePath`, default its key) and saved to its `saveUrl` (default that `url`) with `saveMethod` (default POST) under `saveKey` (default its key), so one section can hold the settings of several apps.
